title: Our Jobs
text:
My name is Anna. I am a doctor. I work in a big hospital in Kyiv. Every day I help sick people.

My brother is a teacher. He works at a school. He teaches children English and math. He likes his job very much.

questions.text: Why does Anna help sick people every day?
options: Because she is bored at work

questions.text: How does the brother feel about his job?

vocabulary.definition: a person who helps sick people
a place where sick people get medical care
a person who teaches students in a school
young people who are not yet adults

paragraph_translations: Мене звати Анна. Я лікар. Я працюю у великій лікарні в Києві. Щодня я допомагаю хворим людям.
Мій брат — вчитель. Він працює в школі. Він навчає дітей англійської та математики. Йому дуже подобається його робота.
